bundles.name: Self-Host Starter Kit
bundles.one_liner: Stand up your own privately-accessible services with HTTPS, uptime alerts, and a Git server — no cloud hosting bill.

bundles.name: API Developer Kit
bundles.one_liner: Build, test, and document an API end to end — contract tests, a CLI tester, SDK generation, and a working MCP server.

bundles.name: Agent Automation Kit
bundles.one_liner: Wire up scheduled tasks, incoming webhooks, and push notifications so your agent can act on events, not just requests.

bundles.name: Publish Your Own Skills Kit
bundles.one_liner: Everything this project itself used to go from a folder of skills to a public, sortable portfolio with a real README.

bundles.name: Content & Docs Kit
bundles.one_liner: Turn structured data and markdown into finished documents — PDFs, slides, resumes, invoices, and a changelog.

bundles.name: Chat Bot Builder Kit
bundles.one_liner: Build a real Discord or Telegram bot with commands and events, wired to webhooks and kept configurable via env vars.
